confidence_notes: Food estimates are based on recent Paracas guides and menu prices, checked against Peru-wide cost-of-living benchmarks; the tourist waterfront can cost more than inland local spots. Wine is estimated at roughly twice a local beer price because a representative glass price was uncertain. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates and were not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Peru-wide prices as a baseline, adjusted for Paracas as a small coastal destination with visitor-oriented restaurants; lodging estimates reflect a modest Peruvian coastal tourism town.
